deals.comment: NAVER Corporation (KOSE:A035420) acquired an additional 17.4% stake in Company AI Co.,Ltd. from Jihoon Kang and others for KRW 870 million on June 5, 2018. Under the terms of transaction, NAVER Corporation acquired 1740 shares at KRW 0.5 million each. NAVER Corporation acquired 1002 shares from Jihoon Kang. Upon completion, NAVER Corporation held 5650 shares in Company AI Co.,Ltd.

deals.buyers: NAVER Corporation (KOSE:A035420); Mirae Asset Financial Group
deals.comment: Mirae Asset Financial Group and NAVER Corporation (KOSE:A035420) acquired two logistics centers in Vietnam for KRW 53 billion on November 9, 2018. The two companies acquired the logistics centers in Yen Phong Industrial Park, located near Hanoi, through their 50:50 joint venture Mirae Asset-Naver Asia Growth Fund. Of the total amount, KRW 30 billion will be funded by the JV while the rest will be taken care of by the Vietnamese unit of Shinhan Investment through refinancing and tenant deposits. Ernst & Young, Korea acted as accountant to the buyers.

NAVER Corporation (KOSE:A035420) acquired additional 17.4% stake in Company AI Co.,Ltd. from Jihoon Kang and others for KRW 870 million on June 5, 2019. Under the transaction, NAVER  acquired 1,740 shares at a price of KRW 500,000 per share out of which 1,002 shares, representing 10.02% stake were acquired from Jihoon Kang. As a result of the transaction, NAVER Corporation holds 73.9% stake in Company AI Co.

NAVER Corporation (KOSE:A035420) acquired remaining 8.7% stake in Company AI Co.,Ltd. from Ji Hoon Kang and others for approximately KRW 440 million on December 4, 2020. As reported, NAVER Corporation will acquire 870 shares in Company AI Co at a price of KRW 500,000 per share. Following the transaction, NAVER Corporation will own 10,000 shares. representing 100% stake in Company AI Co.,Ltd. Ji Hoon Kang will sell 5.01% stake while other shareholder will sell 3.69% stake in Company AI Co.,Ltd.
